description: Roads is a series of datasets listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Infrastructure and Transport. Statewide Road Network including sealed and unsealed roads. The dataset represents navigable roads, including public and private access roads and tracks. A separate data layer stores 'unformed' DCDB centrelines which do not represent navigable roads. A limited number of associated features are stored separately as point features. Automatically updated when changes occur. Coverage: Australia. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Infrastructure and Transport. Its tags are roads, safety, spatial, tracks, transport. It offers 5 resource(s) in GEOJSON, HTML, KML, MAP VIEWER, SHP. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
